source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The constrained form rule changes vertical flex alignment from center to space-around while retaining its 40vh maximum, full block size, vertical scrolling and outline padding. Current address-book and Exchange-settings rules override alignment to start. Read the matching selector and overrides together; the shared group declaration does not establish final alignment for every form. This is static layout evidence, not a rendered scroll-reachability result.
title: Account Hub scrolling forms keep their height limit when alignment changes
